comparison.objective: Press three colored cables into matching comb slots without crossing, versus commission a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Deformable cable routing, alignment, and press insertion; candidate uses rigid tool engagement, bimanual stabilization, fine adjustment, and torque control.
comparison.success_condition: All cables occupy matching slots without crossings; detailed tolerances are absent. Candidate requires measured dynamic behavior and lock retention.
comparison.reason: Cable dressing does not test response-based tuning; shared alignment and pressing primitives are generic.
